construct_ontology: child and adolescent health-related quality of life

metadata.description: European family of health-related quality-of-life questionnaires for children and adolescents.
metadata.intended_use: Cross-cultural health and wellbeing assessment in children and adolescents.
metadata.name_origin: KIDSCREEN names the European child and adolescent quality-of-life project.
metadata.measurement_rationale: A multidimensional profile captures subjective physical, psychological, and social wellbeing.
metadata.interpretation_notes: KIDSCREEN-52, KIDSCREEN-27, and KIDSCREEN-10 are different forms and must use their own scoring and norms.

target_populations.notes: Official KIDSCREEN population; self-report and parent proxy versions exist.

versions.source_citation: Ravens-Sieberer U et al. The KIDSCREEN-52 quality of life measure for children and adolescents: psychometric results from a cross-cultural survey in 13 European countries. Value in Health. 2008;11(4):645-658.

source_documents.title: KIDSCREEN official questionnaire information
source_documents.license_name: Official site states fully open access; verify exact download terms
source_documents.permission_basis: Only bibliographic and discovery metadata is stored. Questionnaire wording and forms are not included until exact edition, language, and reuse terms are verified.

metadata.description: Health-related quality-of-life assessment for children and adolescents aged 8-18.
metadata.intended_use: Screening, monitoring, evaluation, and health-survey research in school or health settings.
metadata.name_origin: KIDSCREEN is the name of the European child and adolescent health-related quality-of-life project.
metadata.development_history: Developed simultaneously in 13 European countries with cross-cultural translation and adaptation.
metadata.measurement_rationale: Separate physical, psychological, social, and school-related wellbeing dimensions describe subjective health-related quality of life.
metadata.interpretation_notes: The official site reports version-specific internal consistency and norm information; use the selected version and country guidance.

versions.item_structure: 52 Items; Dimensionen: health-related quality of life, psychological wellbeing, social wellbeing.
versions.scoring_notes: Die KIDSCREEN-Formen werden dimensionsbezogen nach offizieller Syntax ausgewertet; Normwerte sind landes- und altersbezogen.
versions.psychometric_summary: Offizielle KIDSCREEN-Informationen berichten versionsabhängige interne Konsistenzen und Normen.
